meta.name: gtars
meta.description: Use Gtars for local genomic interval models and set algebra, overlaps and counts, consensus and coverage, tokenization, fragment processing, and refget/BEDbase planning across Python, Rust, and the CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析基因组区间数据并进行集合运算
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效处理基因组区间重叠、计数和覆盖等分析任务
copy.tagline_en: Analyze genomic interval data and perform set operations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need efficient analysis of genomic intervals including overlaps, counts, and coverage

howto.what: Claude 装上 gtars 后，能分析基因组区间数据（如 BED 文件）：检测重叠区域、生成覆盖度轨道（WIG/BigWig）、将基因组区域转化为机器学习用的 token，以及处理单细胞基因组片段等。
howto.when: 当你处理基因组区间文件（BED）、需要检测重叠、生成覆盖度图谱、为机器学习预处理基因组数据，或分析单细胞片段时触发。

say.text: 用 gtars 找出这两个 BED 文件中的重叠区域。
say.note: 会调用 IGD 索引并返回重叠区间。

say.text: 用 gtars 生成 ATAC-seq 片段的覆盖度轨道。
say.note: 会输出 WIG 或 BigWig 文件。

say.text: 用 gtars 的 tokenizer 把训练区域变成机器学习 token。
say.note: 适用于后续 ML 模型训练。

howto.what_en: After installing gtars, Claude can analyze genomic interval data (e.g., BED files): detect overlaps, generate coverage tracks (WIG/BigWig), tokenize genomic regions for machine learning, and process single-cell fragment files.
howto.when_en: Triggered when working with genomic interval files (BED), needing overlap detection, coverage track generation, genomic ML preprocessing, or fragment analysis in single-cell genomics.

say_en.text: Use gtars to find overlapping regions between these two BED files.
say_en.note: Calls IGD index and returns overlapping intervals.

say_en.text: Generate a coverage track from ATAC-seq fragments using gtars.
Tokenize training regions into ML tokens using gtars tokenizer.
say_en.note: Suitable for subsequent ML model training.
